title: Re-prove closure-bound final closure for published source
goal: After the early T004 activation-mechanism proof and T010 post-merge source seal are terminal and independently reviewed, repeat the managed Nix/NixOS final build proof using only artifact.heim-pc.nixos-published-source. Realize a fresh immutable storage-target system closure from the exact T009 merge-commit tree sealed by T010 and emit receipt-bound evidence for that exact closure without activating it. This T011 closure—not the earlier T004/T006 closure—is the only final closure identity that T003 may activate after T003 has created and independently read back its disposable storage target.

approval.note: This approval gates only the managed Nix Build effect that realizes the final closure in the exclusively reserved disposable service.heim-pc-nixos-activation-sandbox. The managed-build receipt must use the Build effect class and bind the exact T010 published-source identity, locked inputs and resulting closure. This approval does not authorize the Activation effect class, switch-to-configuration, /run/current-system or boot-state mutation, rollback, storage/partition/LUKS/mkfs effects, EFI/Secure-Boot/firmware mutation or reboot; those final-source runtime proofs belong only to T003.

acceptance.assertion: T004 is terminal and independently reviewed, proving the receipt-bound managed build/activation, fail-closed denial and rollback mechanism on the earlier T006 source. T011 treats T004 as mechanism evidence only; the T004 closure identity is explicitly not accepted as the final T003 closure identity.

T010 is terminal and independently reviewed. T011 binds the exact immutable artifact.heim-pc.nixos-published-source manifest/digest to the exact T009 merge commit/tree, T009 Captain merge receipt, reviewed T008 PR identity, predecessor ancestry, Control Release Set and lock/input identity. Any artifact/tree/receipt drift fails closed before the final build. T010's historical wording that called T011 the final activation-reproof consumer is retained only as immutable source-seal provenance from the pre-repair contract; it is not accepted as effect authority and does not override the repaired T011-build/T003-activation boundary.

Before source bytes are read, T011 holds the artifact.heim-pc.nixos-published-source read claim materialized as the exact artifact path lease and independently re-hashes its immutable manifest/content against T010 terminal evidence.

Final-build source acquisition reads only the leased T010 published-source artifact. T011 has no /home/alex/repos/heim-pc/.git lease and no mutable source-path lease; any Git object-store, checkout, branch/main, mutable-lock or unpinned-remote reevaluation fails closed before the build.

Before the managed Build effect, T011 holds the exclusive service.heim-pc-nixos-activation-sandbox claim solely as disposable build isolation and executor serialization. That reservation authorizes no Activation effect: no activation receipt may be consumed or minted by T011, and switch-to-configuration, /run/current-system/boot-state mutation and rollback remain forbidden.

Using only the verified T010 published-source artifact and receipt-bound inputs while holding the exclusive build-isolation reservation, a fresh managed Build effect realizes the immutable NixOS storage-target system closure and emits a receipt binding the exact T009 merge commit/tree, T010 artifact digest, Control Release Set, locked inputs, Build effect class and closure. The managed-build receipt is not an Activation receipt and cannot authorize activation.

Independent read-only closure inspection proves the exact T011 system closure exists, contains an executable switch-to-configuration entrypoint and carries the expected storage-target configuration. An internal configurationRevision such as prototype-unbound is not treated as source authority when the source archive contains no .git; exact source identity remains externally bound by the T010 artifact and T011 build receipt.

Missing, stale, mismatched or unauthorized T004/T010/artifact/review/build-sandbox/Build-approval/build-receipt/closure evidence is rejected before T011 terminalization. No denied path performs an Activation effect, switch-to-configuration, mutates /run/current-system or boot state, or creates/mutates partitions, filesystems or LUKS state.

T011 terminal evidence designates the fresh published-source-built closure plus its exact source/build receipts as T003's only final closure identity. T003 must reject the earlier T004 closure or any T011 evidence not bound to the exact T010 artifact/T009 merge tree. Activation authority, live closure readback and rollback evidence are produced only later by T003 inside its disposable storage-rehearsal sandbox.

T011 terminates without switch-to-configuration, productive nixos-rebuild switch, boot activation, /run/current-system mutation, storage/partition/LUKS/mkfs effects, production EFI/Secure-Boot/firmware mutation, Heim-PC reboot or any equivalent runtime/cutover effect.

The exact T004 mechanism evidence, T010 source artifact, T011 managed build receipt and immutable closure/read-only inspection evidence are independently reviewed before T011 is terminal. T011 contains no activation, live-runtime or rollback proof.
